marketCategories.name: Governed Product-to-Operations decision and evidence system
marketCategories.definition: Maintains governed Product and Initiative truth, human authority, traceability, and lifecycle evidence across Product-to-Operations decisions.

marketCategories.name: Specification-driven development toolkit or IDE
marketCategories.definition: Structures requirements, design, tasks, and implementation around versioned specifications.
exclusionCriteria: General requirements database without implementation workflow

marketCategories.name: AI coding and engineering agent
marketCategories.definition: Reads or changes code and executes bounded engineering tasks through an agentic interface.

marketCategories.name: Repository-native DevSecOps platform
marketCategories.definition: Combines repository, planning, CI/CD, security, and delivery controls around software repositories.

marketCategories.name: Product discovery and requirements platform
marketCategories.definition: Captures product intent, evidence, priorities, requirements, and roadmaps before or alongside delivery.

marketCategories.name: Enterprise architecture and transformation platform
marketCategories.definition: Maintains connected business, application, technology, and transformation architecture information.

marketCategories.name: Engineering or application lifecycle management platform
marketCategories.definition: Connects requirements, changes, tests, configurations, and evidence across complex engineering lifecycles.

marketCategories.name: Product design and developer handoff platform
marketCategories.definition: Supports collaborative product design, design systems, prototypes, and implementation handoff.
exclusionCriteria: Full engineering governance without design capability

marketCategories.name: Enterprise business application
marketCategories.definition: Runs operational business processes rather than governing how software products are conceived and engineered.

capabilities.name: Product intent and discovery
capabilities.definition: Capture problems, users, outcomes, evidence, priorities, and bounded Product intent.

capabilities.name: Governed source grounding and provenance
capabilities.definition: Bind decisions to exact reviewed sources, revisions, baselines, and lineage.

capabilities.name: Human authority and proposal/accept/commit separation
capabilities.definition: Keep AI proposals, human acceptance, durable commit, approval, and authorization distinct.

capabilities.name: Initiative classification, applicability, and tailoring
capabilities.definition: Classify a bounded change and tailor lifecycle work without treating absence as not applicable.

capabilities.name: Business architecture
capabilities.definition: Model capabilities, value streams, operating model, business rules, and baseline.

capabilities.name: Domain discovery, EventStorming, and DDD
capabilities.definition: Discover domain behavior and bounded language without forcing one method universally.

capabilities.name: Architecture views and decisions
capabilities.definition: Maintain architecture views, decisions, dependencies, rationale, and impact.

capabilities.name: Architecture-before-slice implementation
capabilities.definition: Require sufficient architecture context before implementation slices are authorized.

capabilities.name: Product Design and tool-neutral adapters
capabilities.definition: Govern Product Design inputs and handoff while keeping design tools replaceable.

capabilities.name: Architecture-bound backlog
capabilities.definition: Trace backlog items to Product intent, architecture, constraints, risks, and decisions.

capabilities.name: Implementation agents and code generation
capabilities.definition: Use agents to inspect repositories, edit code, run tools, and produce reviewable changes.

capabilities.name: Multi-repository and repository federation
capabilities.definition: Coordinate exact context, ownership, and evidence across repositories without flattening authority.

capabilities.name: Tests, assurance, traceability, and evidence
capabilities.definition: Connect tests, assurance claims, risks, decisions, and evidence across lifecycle records.

capabilities.name: Release, deployment, and operations feedback
capabilities.definition: Connect release/deployment controls and operational learning back to Product truth.

capabilities.name: Enterprise privacy, deployment, and administrative controls
capabilities.definition: Provide documented deployment, identity, privacy, policy, and administration options.

capabilities.name: Auditability and portability
capabilities.definition: Produce inspectable histories and portable records without confusing logs with approval.

capabilities.name: Provider neutrality and extensibility
capabilities.definition: Allow replaceable providers/adapters and bounded extensions without moving Product authority into a vendor.

landscapeEvaluations.rationale: Spec-driven agentic IDE overlaps specification and implementation but reviewed evidence does not establish GAEP-style governed Product-to-Operations authority.
Spec-driven toolkit structures specification-to-implementation work but does not establish an enterprise Product governance system.
Coding agent can execute engineering work; it is a narrower choice when teams need implementation assistance rather than a governance system.
Coding agent can execute repository work; it is not evidenced as a Product-to-Operations governance authority.
Coding assistant and cloud agent support engineering work and review, with a narrower lifecycle scope than GAEP's proposed category.
Developer assistant overlaps implementation support but reviewed evidence does not establish the complete GAEP governance model.
Repository-native DevSecOps platform covers planning through operations and controls, but not the same governed Product/Initiative evidence model.
Integrated development services cover planning through release but do not evidence the same cross-functional Product truth model.
Product discovery and roadmapping can satisfy teams whose need stops at discovery-to-delivery linkage.
Product management platform can satisfy discovery, prioritization, and roadmap needs without full engineering governance.
Enterprise architecture platform overlaps business/technology mapping and governance but not implementation-agent orchestration.
Engineering lifecycle suite overlaps requirements, design, tests, configuration, and traceability with a different operating model.
ALM platform overlaps requirements, tests, release, traceability, and audit workflows with a different Product scope.
Design and handoff platform is a likely adapter/complement; it is not treated as a full GAEP substitute.
ERP is retained as one enterprise-product example but runs business operations and is not a software Product-governance substitute.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Product definition/adoption and discovery records are implemented and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: No clean enterprise Product Owner acceptance or outcome evidence is implied.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Exact candidate Source, Baseline, and Provenance records are implemented and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Candidate Sources and Baselines do not create authority or semantic correctness.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Proposal, review, accept, and commit separation is implemented across canonical records.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Approval and authorization remain separate and no complete clean-workspace acceptance is recorded.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Initiative definition, classification, and exact 49-subject applicability are implemented and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Role recommendations appoint nobody and do not approve lifecycle work.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Five business-architecture record paths are implemented and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Only a subset has complete real V5 visual acceptance evidence.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Business understanding and domain-oriented authoring/presentation paths are implemented.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Method fitness and complete installed acceptance remain human decisions.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Solution, bounded-context, security/privacy, and decision record paths are implemented and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: No complete fresh Product Owner acceptance exists for the full group.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Journey ordering and candidate checkpoints can put architecture context before downstream work.
gaepMaturity.limitation: A complete authorization gate that prevents every premature implementation slice is not established.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Design import and handoff contracts exist with a replaceable adapter boundary.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Tool-neutral Product Design governance and installed acceptance are incomplete.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Journey records and exports can trace implementation-oriented work to upstream context.
gaepMaturity.limitation: A complete architecture-bound backlog and selective downstream realignment UX remain incomplete.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Replaceable managed agents execute bounded engineering tasks with deterministic tests.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Live-provider semantic quality and effectful enterprise acceptance remain separate.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Repository federation is recorded as future Product work.
gaepMaturity.limitation: It is not a shipped GAEP capability.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Tests, assurance/evidence records, trace records, and fail-closed local audit verification are broadly implemented.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Local integrity is not external signing, compliance, or organizational approval.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Managed runs and evidence workflows exist and deterministic examples cover release-adjacent behavior.
gaepMaturity.limitation: A complete production operations feedback loop and release authority are not implemented.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Local provider selection, sandboxed execution boundaries, and host controls are implemented in bounded form.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Enterprise privacy, identity, deployment, retention, and administrative control claims are not established.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Hash-chain verification, immutable history, and derived portable exports are implemented.
gaepMaturity.limitation: No external signature, organizational audit acceptance, or universal portability claim is supported.

gaepMaturity.rationale: Provider adapters and host boundaries are replaceable and tested.
gaepMaturity.limitation: Current provider availability, entitlement, equivalence, and native Kiro parity remain unverified.

claims.wording: GAEP currently implements and automatically tests exact candidate Source, Baseline, Provenance, revision-history, and local audit-chain behaviors.
limitations: Implementation evidence does not establish Product Owner acceptance, security certification, compliance, or production readiness.
requiredQualifiers: Say implemented and automated-tested; do not say approved or enterprise-ready.
claims.freshnessTrigger: Relevant repository code/test or accepted baseline changes.

claims.wording: The reviewed landscape is composite: coding agents, spec-driven tools, DevSecOps platforms, Product discovery tools, architecture platforms, ALM suites, and design tools cover different parts of GAEP's proposed scope.
limitations: This is a coverage observation from reviewed official sources, not a superiority or market-share claim.
requiredQualifiers: State the 2026-08-08 as-of date and reviewed-source limitations.
claims.freshnessTrigger: Any product identity, category, capability, or reviewed evidence changes.

claims.wording: A coding agent can be the better-scoped choice when the need is repository implementation assistance rather than governed Product-to-Operations decision management.
limitations: Better-scoped refers to narrower functional fit, not product quality or superiority.
requiredQualifiers: Describe the team's need and do not rank agent quality.
claims.freshnessTrigger: Coding-agent or GAEP implementation scope changes.

claims.wording: No single reviewed external Product was established as a complete direct substitute for GAEP's proposed combined category.
limitations: Absence from reviewed evidence is not proof of market absence; broader research and Product Owner decision are required.
requiredQualifiers: Keep as a hypothesis; never state that competitors lack a capability.
claims.freshnessTrigger: Landscape scope, evidence, or inclusion criteria changes.

claims.wording: GAEP reduces delivery time, improves accuracy, and lowers engineering cost.
limitations: No controlled baseline, observation window, customer evidence, or decision threshold exists.
requiredQualifiers: Do not use until separately measured and approved.
claims.freshnessTrigger: A valid outcome study and publication approval are created.

claims.wording: GAEP is enterprise-ready, secure, compliant, and production-ready.
limitations: No exact organizational, security, compliance, certification, or readiness authority supports this statement.
claims.freshnessTrigger: Separate exact authorities and evidence are created and approved.

proofOfValueMetrics.name: Time to decision-ready trusted context
proofOfValueMetrics.definition: Elapsed and active human time from bounded intent to a reviewable evidence-linked decision package.
proofOfValueMetrics.baseline: Measure the same workflow without GAEP before pilot; no value is predeclared.
proofOfValueMetrics.observationWindow: Predeclared pilot window covering comparable work items.
proofOfValueMetrics.decisionThreshold: Must be set by an accountable human before observation; unset in P02.

proofOfValueMetrics.name: Post-decision rework and escaped gaps
proofOfValueMetrics.definition: Count and severity of material corrections attributable to missing or inconsistent upstream context after a decision.
proofOfValueMetrics.baseline: Historical comparable cases with the same severity rubric.
proofOfValueMetrics.observationWindow: Decision through the predeclared downstream milestone.
proofOfValueMetrics.decisionThreshold: Must be predeclared with a countermetric for review burden; unset in P02.

proofOfValueMetrics.name: Author and reviewer burden
proofOfValueMetrics.definition: Active author/reviewer minutes, queue delay, and mandatory interactions per governed change.
proofOfValueMetrics.baseline: Observed current workflow segmented by role and risk.
proofOfValueMetrics.observationWindow: Full author-review-decision cycle for comparable cases.
proofOfValueMetrics.decisionThreshold: Must balance quality and trust outcomes; unset in P02.
